what: Hoisted cap check would allow cap-resume success without proving the previous round exists
scenario_or_breakage: With --starting-round 999 or a missing round artifact, the proposed STARTING_ROUND > entry_effective_cap branch returns mav-resume-past-cap and Step 5 can proceed as complete without a real prior review round
suggested_fix: Only emit mav-resume-past-cap after validating evidence of a completed prior round or MAV resume source; keep missing artifacts as starting-round-invalid unless the prior round artifact/sentinel exists

what: Proposed cap-boundary test math contradicts the cap logic
scenario_or_breakage: Five prior DEGRADED_ROUND=true files make entry_effective_cap=10, so STARTING_ROUND=6 is not past cap and the asserted mav-resume-past-cap path will not fire
suggested_fix: Use DEGRADED_ROUND=false for the STARTING_ROUND=6/base_cap=5 past-cap case, and add a separate degraded-inflation case with STARTING_ROUND=11 when five prior rounds are degraded

what: New test section can be added but not exercised by targeted harnesses
scenario_or_breakage: The harness currently accepts only dispatch/convergence/parsers and CI shard targets call only those three sections, so a sibling step5-starting-round section would be rejected directly and skipped by make lint
suggested_fix: Integrate the cases into an existing section or update the section whitelist plus Makefile shard target and shard coverage wiring

what: Plan assumes sync can fix a MAV writer race, but mav-apply does not write the probed env artifact
scenario_or_breakage: If the missing file is tied to the MAV apply handoff, retrying stat after sync cannot create round-N/review-and-fix.env, so the root handoff remains uncontracted
suggested_fix: Make the writer contract explicit: have mav-apply write or preserve a minimal resume sentinel/env file, or probe an artifact that mav-apply actually writes such as coder.env plus a completion marker
